dataset: Azure AI Search sample data: good-books

attribution.readme_description: Contains a CSV file containing 10,000 book titles.
attribution.readme_usage: Tutorial: Add search to static web apps
attribution.license_note: No license established for this CSV. The repository root LICENSE endpoint returned HTTP 404; the README good-books section supplies no license. No license or upstream attribution beyond the source repository is inferred.

preservation.metadata: All original nonempty values are retained verbatim as labeled text, including IDs, ratings, publication year, language, ISBN values, and image URLs.
preservation.isbn13: Scientific-notation values in the source are already lossy. They are preserved as strings, never repaired or expanded.
preservation.limitations: Metadata only. No genres, plot summaries, full text, or independently verified bibliographic details are supplied.

search_mapping.title: Unmodified title
search_mapping.content: Source and limitations followed by each nonempty CSV field with its original field name and value
search_mapping.url_note: URL constructed from the dataset's Goodreads ID; external page availability and identity have not been independently validated.
search_mapping.scope: Upload or merge book documents into an existing index; no deletions, schema changes, service changes, or RBAC changes.
search_mapping.verification: Check every upload result, then retrieve and compare all four mapped fields for every imported book using exact ID filters, plus representative exact-key GETs and an index-wide count.
